## Definition of Done

Every item in this sprint must meet:
- [ ] All acceptance criteria from the backlog item met
- [ ] Unit and integration tests written and passing
- [ ] QA reviewed and approved
- [ ] Design reviewed against spec (for UI work)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No critical/high bugs introduced
- [ ] Analytics events verified (if applicable)
